Lightricks/LTX-2.5 is a gated HF repo (auto-gated) — we could not inspect its file listing without an HF_TOKEN with the license accepted, so this name follows the LTX-2.3 convention (ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1.safetensors) rather than a confirmed 2.5 filename. Correct this once models/download.sh --with-ltx has actually pulled the repo — check `ls $ADS_CREATIVE_MODELS_ROOT/ltx-2.5/` and update.

_meta.title: Load Gemma Text Encoder
_meta.note: Node name/inputs confirmed by decoding the official example workflow shipped in Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo (example_workflows/2.3/LTX-2.3_T2V_I2V_Single_Stage_Distilled_Full.json). Its CLIP-typed output feeds a plain CLIPTextEncode below — same as any other ComfyUI CLIP loader.

inputs.text: worst quality, blurry, distorted, static image, frozen, low motion, watermark

_meta.title: LTXV Preprocess
_meta.note: Dropped the ResizeImageMaskNode 'scale longer dimension' pre-step present in the official example — simplification, not verified as safe to omit. If output quality suffers, insert a resize-to-{{width}}x{{height}} step here before preprocess.

_meta.title: Empty LTXV Latent Video (9:16, 5s @ 24fps)
_meta.note: 121 frames / 24fps = 5.04s, matching the official example's frame count (a valid VAE-stride length: 8*15+1). width/height default to 576x1024 (exact 9:16, both multiples of 32 — LTX's VAE spatial stride) when {{width}}/{{height}} aren't substituted with something else.

_meta.title: Empty Audio Latent
_meta.note: LTX-2.x is a joint audio/video model — sampling requires a concatenated AV latent even when audio output is discarded (see LTXVConcatAVLatent below). Widget values [97, 25, 1] mirrored as-is from the official example; exact parameter meaning (frames / sample-rate-divisor / batch?) not independently confirmed — this node has no documented standalone spec outside that example file.

_meta.title: CFG Guider
_meta.note: Chose this simpler branch over the official example's alternate MultimodalGuider+GuiderParameters(AUDIO/VIDEO) path — that path needs two more custom nodes we did not verify are bundled/stable, for a benefit (per-modality CFG weighting) this single-output silent-video use case doesn't need. cfg=1 matches the distilled model's official example value.

_meta.title: Create Video
_meta.note: Audio branch (LTXVAudioVAEDecode on node 17's audio_latent output) intentionally not wired in — silent 9:16 clip only, per the task scope. If CreateVideo's `audio` input turns out to be required (not optional) rather than nullable, add LTXVAudioVAEDecode(samples=[17,1], audio_vae=[1,2]) and wire its output here.
